title: Chapter 387 Who Is The Opponent?
content:
Chapter 387 Who Is The Opponent?

He didn't dare to be careless. He immediately held his breath and concentrated his mind, poured his internal force into his arms, and crossed his hands to protect his chest.

"Bang."

After a loud noise, Wang Shuo took a few steps back.

Zhao Bangde also took a step back slightly.

This made Zhao Bangde very satisfied. Although it was not a sneak attack, the time left for Wang Shuo to react was very short. Although he only used 30% of his strength, Wang Shuo was able to take only a few steps back, which was amazing enough.

"Very good, it seems that the War General Tower is indeed a good place. Tell me what the situation is inside."

Zhao Bangde hadn't been so happy for a long time. He walked up to Wang Shuo and patted Wang Shuo on the shoulder.

Wang Shuo was about to answer, and a voice immediately appeared in his mind, telling him not to disclose any situation in the Shura War General Tower.

At the same time, he couldn't say the situation.

Wang Shuo knew in his heart that this must be the rule of the War General Tower.

"Sorry, I don't seem to be able to tell the situation." Wang Shuo explained helplessly.

"What a pity!" Zhao Bangde's disappointment flashed across his face.

Then he pulled Wang Shuo and walked towards the back hall.

After the two sat down, they chatted about family matters. There were wine and food on the table. Wang Shuo hadn't enjoyed such exquisite food for a long time, so he immediately started to eat with relish.

The two slowly talked about the Great Wall of Steel.

"According to the report of the garrison stationed near the Great Wall of Steel, the barrier outside the Great Wall of Steel has loosened. In the next few days, the barrier may disappear."

Wang Shuo put down his chopsticks, swallowed the food in his mouth, and wiped his mouth.

"It seems that we have to fight again."

"Do you know who our opponent is?"

"Not yet." Zhao Bangde said with some concern.

Wang Shuo told Zhao Bangde in detail what he had learned.

Zhao Bangde's expression changed and he looked serious.

"So, the opponents are some early lords of the Shenwu Empire?"

"It may also be the monsters of the Wagri Empire."

"This matter is of great importance. It seems that we have to join forces with the Black Dragon King to fight against it."

The opponents who fought to the death in the past are now becoming allies. This is really - things are unpredictable!

It really fits the saying that there are no eternal enemies, only eternal interests.

The two discussed the next details, and Wang Shuo went back to Wana County.

Zhao Bangde went to meet with the Black Dragon King to discuss the alliance.

Wang Shuo went back to reorganize the army and prepare to march towards the Great Wall of Steel.

This time, this battle must be won, and it must be performed very amazingly.

After all, this is his Shura Trial mission.

As far as he knows, after completing the final trial mission, he will be awarded a title, and he is full of expectations for this.

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo immediately reorganized the army and held a grand military parade.

Resource exchange stones have also been upgraded to level three, and can be used to exchange items such as legion orders.

Wang Shuo immediately exchanged a large number of items. Under the management of Duan Wenxi and others, Wana County has accumulated more than 30 million energy crystals, which is enough for Wang Shuo to squander.

Reorganized the army.

At present, the army of Wana County includes: the Hell Knights directly under Wang Shuo and managed by Ye Tianba, with the number of people expanded to 3,000.

Ayub's Golden Fire Cavalry, 5,000 people.

Good's Archer Cavalry, 3,000 people.

Gong Zheng's Heavy Shield Infantry, 3,000 people.

Gong Ping's Black Mountain Bandits, 3,000 people, Gong Kai's Archer Battalion, 3,000 people, Li Jianguo's Crossbow Battalion, 5,000 people.

Li Weiguo's Sword Guards, 3,000 people, Li Baoguo's Spearmen, 3,000 people.

There are also Baili Liang's city defense troops of 10,000 people.

The total force reached more than 40,000 people, and their levels were all above level 50.

It can be said that it is the strongest army except for Shanhai City.
